name: rust_bench
description: ADK coordinator (Gemini) for the Rust Mersenne prime agents. Delegates single calculations over A2A and runs the benchmark through a tool.

skills.name: Rust Mersenne primes
skills.description: Find the first N Mersenne primes with the native or exec Rust agent, or benchmark both.
examples: Use the native agent to find the first 12 Mersenne primes
Benchmark both agents for N=1..20 with 5 reps
